senses.definition: One who finds or discovers something; a discoverer.

quotes.text: The finder of treasure trove owns it against the landowner and everyone else except the true owner.
quotes.reference: 2012, Alan R. Romero, Property Law For Dummies, page 229:

senses.definition: A device, such as a viewfinder, used to locate a target or other object of interest.

quotes.text: Perhaps some electrical finder could have been developed so delicate that it could have located the source of all this spreading joy and fortune.

senses.definition: (UK, historical) A person who picks up scraps and oddments to sell to make a living.

quotes.text: Even the Whitechapel meat-market is less the scene of prey, for it is a series of shops, while Leadenhall presents many stalls, and the finders seem loath to enter shops without some plausible pretext.
